findings.title: immediateDelete branch cancels the email but leaves the WorkflowReminder row behind
findings.description: In `deleteScheduledEmailReminder`, when `immediateDelete` is true and a `referenceId` exists, the function sends the cancel request to the email provider and then returns. It neither deletes the `workflowReminder` row nor sets `cancelled: true`. The SMS path and the null-referenceId path both remove the row. Callers that pass `true`, including the workflow-deletion and step-deletion paths in `workflows.tsx` and the reschedule path in `handleNewBooking.ts` (around line 966), leave `scheduled=true` rows that the cron in `scheduleEmailReminders.ts` never picks up, because that cron only selects `cancelled: true` rows and unscheduled rows.

findings.title: Cron cancel loop sends null referenceIds to the provider
findings.description: The `findMany` selects every row with `cancelled: true` and `scheduledDate <= now+1h`, with no filter on `referenceId` or `scheduled`. The loop then calls `client.request` with `batch_id: reminder.referenceId`. `referenceId` is nullable, so reminders that were never scheduled at the provider will send a cancel request with a null batch id.

findings.title: Deletes are lost if an earlier cancel request throws
findings.description: Each `prisma.workflowReminder.delete(...)` returns a lazy `PrismaPromise` that only runs when awaited. The loop pushes these promises into an array and awaits them only after the loop. If `client.request` throws on any iteration, the `catch` logs the error and the pushed deletes never run. Reminders already cancelled at the provider stay in the database, and the remaining reminders in the batch are skipped.

findings.title: try/catch in handleNewBooking cannot catch the errors it is meant to handle
findings.description: The `try` wraps a `forEach` whose callbacks call async functions without awaiting them. Any promise rejection from `deleteScheduledEmailReminder` or `deleteScheduledSMSReminder` escapes the `catch`. The `log.error` branch is effectively dead for async failures, and the reschedule flow continues as if the cleanup succeeded.

findings.title: deleteScheduledSMSReminder skips the row delete when the Twilio cancel fails
findings.description: `twilio.cancelSMS` and `prisma.workflowReminder.delete` share one `try`. If the Twilio call throws, the database delete never runs, and the error is only logged with `console.log`. The reminder row is left in place with no retry path.

findings.title: PrismaPromise import in workflows.tsx is now unused
findings.description: `PrismaPromise` was moved into the value import from `@prisma/client`. Its only usage in the diff, `deleteReminderPromise: PrismaPromise<Prisma.BatchPayload>[]`, was removed. The same applies to `Prisma`, which was used only in that removed annotation within the diff. Both are now dead imports, and `PrismaPromise` is a type that does not need a value import.

findings.title: smsReminderManager.ts now calls prisma without an import visible in the diff
findings.description: The new `prisma.workflowReminder.delete` call relies on a `prisma` binding. The diff does not show an import for it in this file. I could not confirm whether the import already exists, so this is unverified.
